```{r}
# Make results reproducible
set.seed(5571)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(matrixStats)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

# Define sample size
n <- 5 # you'll also try 10, 30, 100, and 500

# Simulate datasets from different populations with the same mean and standard deviation
mu <- 10
sigma <- 10
# Population 1: normal
data1 <- rnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = sigma)
# Population 2: skewed distribution
data2 <- rgamma(n, shape = mu^2/sigma^2, scale = sigma^2/mu)
# Population 3: propose your own (but make sure the population mean and SD match the other 2 populations)
```
